about: Design features the design docs describe that are not built yet (status pending), and those that have landed since (status release, landed_in). Each pending row is flagged where the docs describe it: [not yet in the current release](pending:<id>). docs/design/language/status.md is generated from this file (node scripts/docs/design.mjs --write-status).

capabilities.title: Volatile values recorded in runmat.lock at release
capabilities.acceptance: Releasing a design snapshots every volatile value it used into runmat.lock under [values], and regenerating the released design reads the snapshot.

capabilities.title: Values with units across the .m boundary
capabilities.acceptance: A design value function receives quantities for parameters declared quantity.<Kind> in its arguments block and may return a quantity, which the call converts and checks without `as`.

capabilities.title: Circuit component values from .m functions
capabilities.acceptance: A .circuit component value or param may call a .m function in the circuit's folder, with the same resolution, units, determinism and cache rules as a .part value.

capabilities.title: runmat-design check on parts, assemblies and drawings
capabilities.acceptance: runmat-design check runs design.check on .part, .assembly and .drawing files, prints each diagnostic and exits 1 on any error.

capabilities.title: runmat check and runmat test on parts, assemblies and drawings
capabilities.acceptance: runmat check and runmat test delegate .part, .assembly and .drawing files to the design checks, as they do .circuit and .circuit.layout files, beside .m and .fea files.

capabilities.title: Input values for one export
capabilities.acceptance: design.export takes set (input values for one run), with minimum and maximum range checks, so a study's geometry can come from a part at chosen inputs.

capabilities.title: cad.evaluate, cad.study, cad.check and cad.inputs in MATLAB-language code
capabilities.acceptance: A .m script regenerates a part or an assembly at input values with cad.evaluate and reads its mass properties, bounding box and published values; cad.study runs a .fea study at its inputs; cad.check judges limits and throws cad:limitFailed, which runmat test reports as a failure; cad.inputs lists the inputs; parfor runs one regeneration per worker.

capabilities.title: Cam mates
capabilities.acceptance: An assembly writes kind = { mate = cam, profile = <published profile> }; the solver keeps the follower point on the cam's profile path as the cam turns (a path-tangent residual), with its Jacobian checked.

capabilities.title: Drawings laid out automatically
capabilities.acceptance: A command writes a .drawing for a part or an assembly with standard views, dimensions from its PMI and a title block, and the result checks clean.

capabilities.title: Drawing standards
capabilities.acceptance: A sheet format selects an ISO or ASME standard that sets line weights, text, arrowheads and tolerance display in the Desktop sheet and the DXF, DWG and PDF exports.

capabilities.title: Surface and shape analysis
capabilities.acceptance: Evaluate runs section, thickness, undercut, curvature, zebra and deviation analyses on a part in the Desktop and through design.inspect, coloring the model by result as draft analysis does.

capabilities.title: Studies that name a design
capabilities.acceptance: A .fea geometry block takes part = <name> or assembly = <name> with inputs, resolved through the folder scope, and the study regenerates the design at those inputs without a STEP export.

capabilities.title: Boards in their enclosures
capabilities.acceptance: An assembly that places a board and its enclosure checks fit and clearance between the board's components and the enclosure's parts.

capabilities.title: Board studies through the pcb source
capabilities.acceptance: Board » Analysis » New study writes a .fea study beside the layout that reads the board's stackup, copper, pads and component power through FEA's pcb geometry source, and FEA checks and runs its thermal, IR drop and warpage studies. Until the source lands, FEA's check answers "pcb geometry source is not yet available" and the Desktop shows the study as planned, with the release flag.

capabilities.title: Polarity marks on assembly drawings
capabilities.acceptance: The assembly drawing of each side marks pin 1 and the polarity of polarized parts (diodes, LEDs, polarized capacitors, ICs) beside their outlines and designators, in the Gerber and PDF.

capabilities.title: Imports from other electronics tools
capabilities.acceptance: Clean-room readers for the other common tools' binary, text and JSON schematic and board formats write circuits and boards with part declarations and a report of what did not carry over, tested on an openly licensed corpus.

capabilities.title: KiCad round-trip gate
capabilities.acceptance: A corpus of KiCad projects reads in and writes back with hierarchy, symbols, footprints, net classes and rules intact, and the not-carried report is empty or explained.

capabilities.title: Footprint wizard and footprint editor
capabilities.acceptance: The wizard builds a footprint from a family and datasheet dimensions on the same generator as package strings, saves a generator string when no value was edited and a footprint declaration when one was, and reopens with its values; the footprint editor edits pads, courtyard, silkscreen and fab with undo.

capabilities.title: Footprint, symbol and part library import and export
capabilities.acceptance: A .kicad_mod, a .pretty folder, a .kicad_sym and an XML part library import to library .circuit files with a source note on each declaration, and export writes them back; round-trip tests cover a sample of each.

capabilities.title: Library .circuit files and use
capabilities.acceptance: A .circuit with no circuit block is a library of footprint, symbol and part declarations; use "<path>.circuit" brings them into scope, libraries use other libraries, and duplicate names, cycles and missing files are errors that name the files.

capabilities.title: Field-solved trace impedance beside the closed form
capabilities.acceptance: A board study solves each controlled line's cross-section (from the pcb source's lines) for Z0, Zdiff, delay and per-length L and C, and the layer-stack view shows the solved value beside the closed form.
